units.source_text: 夕雾蒙眬入睡，梦见已故的卫门督身穿便服，坐在他身旁，拿起那支笛来看看。

en.t: Yugiri drifted into a hazy sleep and dreamed that the late Captain of the Gate Guards, dressed in informal robes, sat beside him and picked up that flute to look at it.

units.source_text: 夕雾在梦中想道：“他的亡魂舍不得这支笛，所以寻声而来了！”

en.t: In the dream, Yugiri thought, His departed spirit cannot bear to leave this flute, and so he has come following its sound.
